turns.user: Tin AI hôm nay có gì nổi bật?
turns.assistant_text:
Dưới đây là những tin tức nổi bật về AI hôm nay:

1. **[AI and your job: Threat or opportunity?](https://www.fox10tv.com/2026/11/10/ai-your-job-threat-or-opportunity)** - Bài viết này thảo luận về việc trí tuệ nhân tạo đang trở thành một phần lớn trong cuộc sống hàng ngày, đặt ra câu hỏi về tác động của công nghệ này đối với công việc của người lao động. Một số nhà kinh tế cho rằng AI có thể đe dọa các công việc cấp thấp và lặp đi lặp lại, nhưng cũng có thể tạo ra cơ hội mới trong các lĩnh vực như xây dựng và sản xuất.

2. **[Asia not riding but building the AI boom – GIS Reports](https://www.gisreportsonline.com/r/asia-building-ai-boom)** - Bài viết này phân tích cách các quốc gia châu Á đang tìm cách nổi bật trong cuộc cạnh tranh AI toàn cầu, đồng thời đầu tư vào các ứng dụng mới cho AI trong nhiều ngành công nghiệp. Dự báo tổng chi tiêu toàn cầu cho AI sẽ vượt quá 1 nghìn tỷ USD vào năm 2026.

3. **[China's trade surplus soars past $1 trillion as AI boom powers exports | Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/chinas-trade-surplus-soars-past-1-trillion-october-exports-jump-352-yy-2026-11-10)** - Trung Quốc ghi nhận thặng dư thương mại vượt quá 1 nghìn tỷ USD trong 10 tháng đầu năm, nhờ vào sự bùng nổ đầu tư vào cơ sở hạ tầng AI. Tuy nhiên, điều này cũng có thể làm sâu sắc thêm sự mất cân bằng trong nền kinh tế nội địa.

4. **[UA regents delay statement of intent on AI amid feedback](https://www.alaskasnewssource.com/2026/11/10/ua-regents-delay-statement-intent-ai-amid-feedback)** - Hệ thống đại học Alaska đang xem xét cách tiếp cận đối với AI trong lớp học, với mục tiêu phát triển các nguyên tắc hướng dẫn và kỳ vọng từ ban quản lý.

5. **[Congress’s Permitting Bill Is a ‘Massive Giveaway’ to the AI Data Center Industry, Critics Warn](https://time.com/article/2026/11/10/permitting-bill-data-centers)** - Dự luật mới đang gây tranh cãi, với những người ủng hộ cho rằng nó sẽ mang lại lợi ích cho ngành công nghiệp trung tâm dữ liệu AI, trong khi các nhà phê bình lo ngại về tác động đến môi trường và quyền lợi của người dân.

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin chi tiết về bất kỳ bài viết nào, hãy cho tôi biết!

items.title: AI and your job: Threat or opportunity?
items.summary:
MOBILE, Ala. (WALA) - Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of everyday life, raising questions about what the technology could mean for workers and their jobs.

Some economists believe AI poses a particular threat to entry-level and repetitive work, including call center, data entry and junior copywriting jobs, according to The Wall Street Journal. Those tasks may be easier to automate. [...] But AI could also create opportunities. A Bloomberg article points to potential job growth in construction and manufacturing as companies build data centers and produce the chips that power the technology. Some higher-skilled office workers could also benefit if AI helps them become more productive. [...] The long-term impact on jobs remains unclear, but workers can take steps to prepare. Exploring AI chatbots, writing assistants and other tools may help people find ways to work more efficiently and develop skills that complement the technology.

items.title: China's trade surplus soars past $1 trillion as AI boom powers exports | Reuters
items.summary:
Much of the strength in exports this ​year has been fuelled by a global push to expand AI infrastructure.

"The outlook for exports depends on how long the AI boom will last," Macquarie analysts wrote. They expect China's exports to accelerate ​further in the fourth quarter before starting to slow from the first quarter of 2027.

Reporting by Yukun Zhang, Sam Li and Ryan Woo; Editing by Shri Navaratnam

Our Standards: The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles. [...] BEIJING, Nov 10 (Reuters) - China's trade surplus surged past $1 trillion in the first 10 months as a global race to build AI infrastructure buoyed sales ​of high-tech products and helped offset weak domestic demand, a dynamic likely to sharpen tensions with major trading partners. [...] The figures highlight ‌Beijing's growing reliance on overseas demand to support an economy hobbled by subdued consumption and a protracted property slump. But while the global AI investment boom is expected to keep demand for Chinese technology products strong into 2027, it risks deepening domestic imbalances and fuelling trade frictions with partners including the European Union.

items.title: UA regents delay statement of intent on AI amid feedback
items.summary:
Work on the university system’s intent language began in 2025, Taylor said, when faculty requested guidance from administration on the use of AI in the classroom.

When complete, the document is designed not to act as policy, but simply to outline the approach the UA institution is taking toward AI, develop guiding principles and put forward expectations of future actions from the administration, including eventually coming up with actual policy. [...] “Faculty currently have the ability to decide when and where and how AI can be used in their classroom — if at all — and also in many cases are helping our students better understand how they can use it effectively,” Taylor said, adding that ultimately there will still be flexibility for how different universities and faculty approach AI.

Bài viết "Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet" từ Anthropic thông báo về việc ra mắt Claude 3.5 Sonnet, một mô hình AI mới trong dòng sản phẩm Claude 3.5. Dưới đây là tóm tắt các điểm nổi bật:

1. **Hiệu suất vượt trội**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet thiết lập các tiêu chuẩn mới trong ngành về khả năng lý luận cấp độ cao, kiến thức đại học và khả năng lập trình. Mô hình này hoạt động nhanh gấp đôi so với Claude 3 Opus, giúp thực hiện các tác vụ phức tạp như hỗ trợ khách hàng và quản lý quy trình nhiều bước.

2. **Khả năng lập trình**: Trong một bài kiểm tra lập trình, Claude 3.5 Sonnet đã giải quyết 64% vấn đề, vượt trội hơn so với Claude 3 Opus với 38%. Mô hình này có khả năng viết, chỉnh sửa và thực thi mã với khả năng lý luận và xử lý sự cố tinh vi.

3. **Mô hình thị giác mạnh mẽ**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet là mô hình thị giác mạnh nhất của Anthropic, vượt qua Claude 3 Opus trong các bài kiểm tra thị giác tiêu chuẩn. Nó có khả năng diễn giải biểu đồ và đồ thị, cũng như chính xác trong việc phiên âm văn bản từ hình ảnh không hoàn hảo.

4. **Tính năng mới - Artifacts**: Bài viết cũng giới thiệu tính năng Artifacts trên Claude.ai, mở rộng khả năng sử dụng mô hình này.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet hiện đã có sẵn miễn phí trên Claude.ai và ứng dụng iOS, với các gói Pro và Team có giới hạn sử dụng cao hơn. Mô hình này có giá 3 USD cho mỗi triệu token đầu vào và 15 USD cho mỗi triệu token đầu ra.

Bạn có thể đọc bài viết đầy đủ tại [đây](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-5-sonnet).

items.title: Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet \ Anthropic
items.summary:
[Skip to main content](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-5-sonnet#main-content)

### 01Frontier intelligence at 2x the speed

- UpdateAug 28, 2025



### Consumer Terms and Privacy Policy


Today, we’re launching Claude 3.5 Sonnet—our first release in the forthcoming Claude 3.5 model family. Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry bar for intelligence, outperforming competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on a wide range of evaluations, with the speed and cost of our mid-tier model, Claude 3 Sonnet.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is now available for free on Claude.ai and the Claude iOS app, while Claude Pro and Team plan subscribers can access it with significantly higher rate limits. It is also available via the Anthropic [API](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/home), [Amazon Bedrock](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-model-now-available-in-amazon-bedrock-the-most-intelligent-claude-model-yet/), and [Google Cloud’s Vertex AI](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/announcing-anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-on-vertex-ai-providing-more-choice-for-enterprises). The model costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with a 200K token context window.

![Claude model family](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F1f044104447e9db6b22db3a06e45d114f50f274e-2200x1174.png&w=3840&q=75)

## Frontier intelligence at 2x the speed

Claude 3.5 Sonnet sets new industry benchmarks for graduate-level reasoning (GPQA), undergraduate-level knowledge (MMLU), and coding proficiency (HumanEval). It shows marked improvement in grasping nuance, humor, and complex instructions, and is exceptional at writing high-quality content with a natural, relatable tone.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet operates at twice the speed of Claude 3 Opus. This performance boost, combined with cost-effective pricing, makes Claude 3.5 Sonnet ideal for complex tasks such as context-sensitive customer support and orchestrating multi-step workflows.

In an [internal agentic coding evaluation](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/fed9cc193a14b84131812372d8d5857f8f304c52/Model_Card_Claude_3_Addendum.pdf), Claude 3.5 Sonnet solved 64% of problems, outperforming Claude 3 Opus which solved 38%. Our evaluation tests the model’s ability to fix a bug or add functionality to an open source codebase, given a natural language description of the desired improvement. When instructed and [provided with the relevant tools](https://www.anthropic.com/news/tool-use-ga), Claude 3.5 Sonnet can independently write, edit, and execute code with sophisticated reasoning and troubleshooting capabilities. It handles code translations with ease, making it particularly effective for updating legacy applications and migrating codebases.

![Claude 3.5 Sonnet benchmarks](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fcf2c754458e9102b7334731fb18a965bfeb7ad08-2200x1894.png&w=3840&q=75)

## State-of-the-art vision

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is our strongest vision model yet, surpassing Claude 3 Opus on standard vision benchmarks. These step-change improvements are most noticeable for tasks that require visual reasoning, like interpreting charts and graphs. Claude 3.5 Sonnet can also accurately transcribe text from imperfect images—a core capability for retail, logistics, and financial services, where AI may glean more insights from an image, graphic or illustration than from text alone.

![Video thumbnail](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimg.youtube.com%2Fvi%2FdhxrHvgXpSM%2Fmaxresdefault.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

![Claude 3.5 Sonnet vision evals](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fcaff3d60763b27b59fe33e4ae984530f0dba4ddb-2200x1110.png&w=3840&q=75)

Bạn có thể đọc bài viết đầy đủ tại [đây](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-5-sonnet).

### 01Frontier intelligence at 2x the speed

- UpdateAug 28, 2025



### Consumer Terms and Privacy Policy


Today, we’re launching Claude 3.5 Sonnet—our first release in the forthcoming Claude 3.5 model family. Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry bar for intelligence, outperforming competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on a wide range of evaluations, with the speed and cost of our mid-tier model, Claude 3 Sonnet.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is now available for free on Claude.ai and the Claude iOS app, while Claude Pro and Team plan subscribers can access it with significantly higher rate limits. It is also available via the Anthropic [API](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/home), [Amazon Bedrock](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-model-now-available-in-amazon-bedrock-the-most-intelligent-claude-model-yet/), and [Google Cloud’s Vertex AI](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/announcing-anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-on-vertex-ai-providing-more-choice-for-enterprises). The model costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with a 200K token context window.

![Claude model family](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F1f044104447e9db6b22db3a06e45d114f50f274e-2200x1174.png&w=3840&q=75)

## Frontier intelligence at 2x the speed

Claude 3.5 Sonnet sets new industry benchmarks for graduate-level reasoning (GPQA), undergraduate-level knowledge (MMLU), and coding proficiency (HumanEval). It shows marked improvement in grasping nuance, humor, and complex instructions, and is exceptional at writing high-quality content with a natural, relatable tone.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet operates at twice the speed of Claude 3 Opus. This performance boost, combined with cost-effective pricing, makes Claude 3.5 Sonnet ideal for complex tasks such as context-sensitive customer support and orchestrating multi-step workflows.

In an [internal agentic coding evaluation](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/fed9cc193a14b84131812372d8d5857f8f304c52/Model_Card_Claude_3_Addendum.pdf), Claude 3.5 Sonnet solved 64% of problems, outperforming Claude 3 Opus which solved 38%. Our evaluation tests the model’s ability to fix a bug or add functionality to an open source codebase, given a natural language description of the desired improvement. When instructed and [provided with the relevant tools](https://www.anthropic.com/news/tool-use-ga), Claude 3.5 Sonnet can independently write, edit, and execute code with sophisticated reasoning and troubleshooting capabilities. It handles code translations with ease, making it particularly effective for updating legacy applications and migrating codebases.

![Claude 3.5 Sonnet benchmarks](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fcf2c754458e9102b7334731fb18a965bfeb7ad08-2200x1894.png&w=3840&q=75)

## State-of-the-art vision

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is our strongest vision model yet, surpassing Claude 3 Opus on standard vision benchmarks. These step-change improvements are most noticeable for tasks that require visual reasoning, like interpreting charts and graphs. Claude 3.5 Sonnet can also accurately transcribe text from imperfect images—a core capability for retail, logistics, and financial services, where AI may glean more insights from an image, graphic or illustration than from text alone.

![Video thumbnail](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimg.youtube.com%2Fvi%2FdhxrHvgXpSM%2Fmaxresdefault.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

![Claude 3.5 Sonnet vision evals](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fcaff3d60763b27b59fe33e4ae984530f0dba4ddb-2200x1110.png&w=3840&q=75)
